articles.summary:
US radar facility at Bahrain base attacked with six drones, IRGC claims

Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) said their forces carried out a drone attack on a US radar system at a base in Bahrain, according to a statement carried by the Iranian state broadcaster on Sunday. 

"The U.S. air defence radar system at the Al-Riffa helicopter base in Bahrain was targeted by six drones belonging to the IRGC Aerospace Force," the Guards said in a statement posted by the state broadcaster on Telegram. 

Earlier, Bahrain issued two danger alerts within a span of more than two hours, urging citizens to stay calm and move to safer places.

articles.summary:
West Bank: Israeli forces detain Palestinian journalist, conduct raids

Israeli forces have detained Palestinian journalist Mohammed Ateeq after raiding his home in the town of Burqin, west of Jenin in the occupied West Bank, Quds News Network said.

The Palestinian news agency, Wafa, reported that Israeli forces imposed curfew on Beit Ummar, north of Hebron, forced shop owners to close their businesses, fired stun grenades and tear gas at Palestinians, and deployed military vehicles and infantry troops throughout the town's streets. They also sealed off all entrances and exits to the town with iron gates.

*Israeli forces also raided al-Fawwar refugee camp, south of Hebron, and fired stun grenades and tear gas at camp's residents.

*The forces set up a military checkpoint at al-Saheb junction in Hebron city, where they searched Palestinian vehicles, tampered with their contents, checked Palestinians' identity cards, and subjected them to mistreatment, Wafa reported.

Fire engulfed a Palestinian kiosk in the village of Rummana, west of Jenin, in the occupied West Bank, after Israeli occupation forces fired grenades. https://t.co/Zakc42muZe

— Quds News Network (@QudsNen) November 14, 2026

articles.title: Car bomb in Damascus suburb kills two, including child
articles.summary:
Car bomb in Damascus suburb kills two, including child

A car bomb killed two people, including a child, and wounded another, in a suburb of Damascus on Saturday,  Syrian Arab News Agency (Sana) said.

Authorities had "established a security perimeter at the scene and opened an investigation", it cited security forces as saying.

Syria has frequently been hit by explosions or attacks against civilians or security forces since the fall of former president Bashar al-Assad in December 2024.

In August another blast struck Jaramana, with the attack on a bus wounding 14 people, according to Sana. 

In the capital Damascus, two devices exploded near a hotel where French President Emmanuel Macron was staying during a landmark visit in July.  That blast left one person dead and 36 wounded. 

Authorities blamed an organisation affiliated with the Islamic State group, which has previously claimed several attacks targeting Syrian security forces.

Report by AFP

Současně probíhají vojenské operace a zatýkání na Západním břehu a intenzivní boje v Gaze, zatímco diplomatická fronta vykazuje vysokou aktivitu ohledně íránského jaderného programu.
archive.security_status_en: Regional tensions are escalating due to maritime incidents in the Strait of Hormuz, where at least three oil tankers were struck by mines and Iran reported downing a US drone. Concurrently, military operations and arrests continue in the West Bank alongside intense fighting in Gaza, while diplomatic fronts remain heavily active regarding Iran's nuclear program.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat pokračující napětí v námořní dopravě v oblasti Perského zálivu a zostřenou rétoriku ohledně íránského jaderného programu. Operace v Gaze a na Západním břehu budou nadále udržovat bezpečnostní složky v maximální pohotovosti.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, continued maritime tensions in the Persian Gulf and intensified rhetoric regarding Iran's nuclear program are expected. Operations in Gaza and the West Bank will keep security forces on high alert.

archive.security_status_cs: Bezpečnostní situace v regionu se výrazně vyhrotila po útoku íránských dronů na americké pozice v Bahrajnu. Současně pokračují izraelské vojenské operace v Gaze a na Západním břehu, zatímco Irák podniká vnitřní kroky proti pašeráckým sítím napojeným na Írán.
archive.security_status_en: The regional security situation has significantly escalated following Iranian drone attacks on US positions in Bahrain. Simultaneously, Israeli military operations continue in Gaza and the West Bank, while Iraq takes internal steps against Iran-linked smuggling networks.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat zvýšenou pohotovost amerických sil v Zálivu a diplomatickou odezvu na íránské útoky. Operace v Gaze a Sýrii budou nadále udržovat vysokou úroveň regionálního napětí.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, heightened readiness of US forces in the Gulf and diplomatic responses to the Iranian attacks are expected. Operations in Gaza and Syria will continue to maintain a high level of regional tension.
